cred.monoStep1: Open api.monobank.ua and press “Отримати токен” (get token).
cred.monoStep2: Scan the QR code with the monobank app (Menu → Scanner) and confirm access.
cred.monoStep3: Copy the token shown (it starts with “u”) and paste it in the field below.
cred.monoStep4: The token only reads accounts and the statement — it cannot move money. Monobank allows 1 request per 60 seconds, which is why the first history load runs in batches.
cred.anthropicStep1: Sign up at console.anthropic.com. That is the API console, separate from the claude.ai subscription — Pro/Max does not include API access.
cred.anthropicStep2: Billing → Add credits: top up the balance (minimum $5). With no balance the key returns a credit error.
cred.anthropicStep3: API keys → Create key. Copy the “sk-ant-…” key straight away — it is shown once.
cred.anthropicStep4: Paste it below. This app typically costs $1–2 a month; the running total is in the “AI costs” card above.
cred.factEncrypted: Both keys are stored encrypted in your own database and are never returned — not even masked.
cred.factOwnBilling: Your AI runs on your key and your billing. Other people's usage never touches it.
cred.factNoAiKey: Without an Anthropic key everything except AI works: transaction import, statistics, budgets, subscriptions, goals.

landing.h1: Personal finance that doesn't lie about the numbers.
landing.sub: Bank sync, deterministic categorization, and an AI advisor that reasons over the exact same figures the app shows — never its own.
landing.demoNote: No sign-up · a private sandbox · resets in 24 hours
landing.demoPreparingNote: Seeding six months of sample transactions — this takes a few seconds.
landing.demoLimit: The demo has reached today's limit of new sandboxes. Please try again tomorrow, or sign in if you have an invite.
landing.demoFailed: Could not start the demo. Please try again.
landing.f1Body: One canonical layer computes every number — multi-currency roll-up, sub-categories, splits, refunds, reimbursements, transfers. The UI and the AI read the same source.
landing.f2Body: A deterministic check rejects any figure the AI can't ground in your data, so the advice never invents a number. A check beats an instruction.
landing.f3Body: Your entire database lives in its own Durable Object — physical isolation, no shared tables. Bring your own bank and AI key.
landing.footer: Built as a portfolio project with heavy use of AI. Real accounts are invite-only.
evt.plan.title: Plan vs actual
evt.plan.empty: No plan yet. Add expected costs to compare against actual spend.
login.inviteOnly: Access is invite-only. Not added yet? Ask the owner.
landing.aiNote: AI features run on Anthropic (Claude) models: to make the advisor, chat and reports work, a summary of your financial data is sent to Anthropic. The demo runs on fictional data.
landing.flowAria: Diagram: one canonical calculation layer feeds both the screen and the AI
landing.flowSourceDesc: The canonical layer: currency roll-up, sub-categories, splits, refunds, reimbursements, transfers.
landing.flowFoot: Both read the same numbers — which is why the advice cannot contradict the chart.
landing.keysLead: The demo runs straight away and asks for nothing. A real account takes two of your own keys — entered in Settings, stored encrypted.
landing.keyMonoBody: So transactions sync themselves. The token only reads the statement — it cannot move money. CSV import covers other banks.
landing.keyAiBody: AI is billed to your key, so nobody else's usage touches it (typically $1–2 a month). Without it everything except AI works.
setup.translitNone: No transliterated names found — merchant history is intact.
setup.translitFound: Found {n} name(s) written in Cyrillic over a Latin bank description. That splits a merchant's history in two.
setup.dangerBody: Erases ALL of your data permanently: transactions, accounts, budgets, goals, reports, stored keys. This cannot be undone and no copy is kept. You can export your statement first with the “CSV” button on Transactions.
setup.deleteConfirmHint: Type DELETE in capitals to confirm.
setup.step1Desc: Reads the list of your cards and jars, with their balances and currencies. Nothing is charged and no transactions are fetched yet.
setup.step2Desc: Tells Monobank where to send new transactions, so they appear here within seconds instead of on the next sync.
setup.step3Desc: Loads the last ~90 days of history. One request per minute (Monobank's limit), and each transaction is categorised by AI — this is the step that costs money.
setup.refreshRatesDesc: Caches today's currency rates. Without them foreign-currency accounts cannot be converted to ₴ and totals will be wrong.
setup.firstRunAllDone: Everything is set up. Steps stay here so you can re-run any of them.
dash.setupNudgeBody: Connect Monobank and load your history — until then the dashboard has nothing to show.
dash.aiKeyNudgeBody: The advisor, reports, chat and auto-categorisation run on your own Anthropic key. Everything else works without it.
admin.title: People
admin.sub: This app is invite-only. Add an email here, then that person signs in with Google.
admin.inviteHint: No email is sent — tell them yourself and send the link. They must sign in with the Google account matching this address. While the Google app is in Testing, the address also has to be listed under Test users in Google Cloud.
admin.signupOpen: Registration is OPEN — anyone with a Google account can sign in. To close it, set SIGNUP=invite in wrangler.jsonc and deploy.
admin.signupInvite: Invite-only: only the addresses listed below can sign in.
wd.title: By day of week
wd.subtitle: when the money actually goes
wd.tip: Shows a TYPICAL day: the total is divided by how many such days the period held — otherwise the comparison lies (a month has five Fridays and four Saturdays). A faded bar means one payment (rent, tax) is almost the whole day, so it is about the billing date, not about behaviour.
hb.title: What changed in your regulars
hb.subtitle: started and gone quiet
hb.tip: Based on what the bank actually charged, not on declared subscriptions — so it catches the ones you never set up. NEW: charged in 2 of the last 3 complete months and in none of the 3 before them. GONE QUIET: regular for 3+ months, then silent for 2 complete ones — either cancelled or a payment that failed. The current month is excluded: half a month of data looks exactly like a merchant disappearing.
hb.tracked: “{merchant}” is now a plan — check its period and amount
hb.dismissed: “{merchant}” will not show up here again
